previous_audits.notes_for_re_audit_if_any: missing_bridge_theorem: derive the boundary terms, CAR metric, reflected inner product, and coherent-state normalization from the eliminated action to prove K_2=lambda_-; also declare a_tau=1 or replace E by E/a_tau in H_hat, and compute C2's true minimum over every eigenvalue.
previous_audits.verdict_rationale: Issue: the action-to-physical-CAR/OS identification K_2=lambda_- is explicitly unproved; additionally, C2 minimizes per-mode maxima rather than every |Im eigenvalue|, and Gamma=exp(-2a_tau H_hat) with H_hat=sum_p E(p)n_p requires a_tau=1 or an E/a_tau factor. Why this blocks: a covariance decay ratio does not supply the boundary terms, CAR metric, reflected inner product, or coherent-state normalization needed to identify a physical transfer operator. Repair target: derive that identification from the eliminated action and reconcile the C2 statistic and a_tau normalization. Claim boundary until fixed: the recurrence-matrix nonpositivity and conditional positive factorization Gamma(lambda_-)=B^dag B remain supported, but unconditional physical two-step transfer positivity does not.

previous_audits.chain_closure_explanation: The target-equivalent action-to-physical-CAR/OS identification K_2=lambda_- remains unproved; C7 establishes only the half-line covariance decay ratio. The source also leaves an a_tau normalization ambiguity and misreports C2's minimum imaginary-part statistic.
